findings.source: RateLimiter._setTokenBucketConfig: timeDiff = block.timestamp - s_bucket.lastUpdated; tokens = _calculateRefill(capacity, tokens, timeDiff, rate) (min(capacity, tokens + timeDiff * rate)); s_bucket.tokens = min(config.capacity, tokens); s_bucket.isEnabled = config.isEnabled
findings.issue: The packed TokenBucket slot (uint128 tokens, uint32 lastUpdated, bool isEnabled) is written as one whole-slot expression whose keep-mask is printed as a hex constant times 3600 (P1, P15), and timeDiff * rate is distributed into block.timestamp * rate - lastUpdated * rate in the overflow check and the refill.
findings.rule: Split a masked whole-slot store into its field stores (uint128(field_0) = .., bool(field_160) = ..) and never factor a mask by a time unit; keep a product of a difference as (a - b) * c.

notes: All 49 ABI functions and the fallback reviewed; no semantic error found. lockOrBurn, releaseOrMint, applyChainUpdates, setDomains, getRemotePools, provideLiquidity / withdrawLiquidity, the CCTP migration functions by structure (RMN curse checks, rate-limit consumption, lock-release vs burn-mint branch, CCTP message validation, events). Source loops (9): updateChainSelectorMechanisms' remove and add loops, setDomains, getRemotePools, getSupportedChains, applyChainUpdates' four loops (remove + remove remote pools, add + set remote pools): all whiles. applyAllowListUpdates' two loops are dead because of the immutable (artifact). Implicit: struct-array / bytes[] decodings, EnumerableSet values copies, event encodings (10 plain copies, P7). P8: keccak scratch stores. 36 Error reverts, 5 events and 2 returns are raw memory because of the free-memory-pointer aliasing assumption (counted under P2's root cause in other contracts; here the P2 regex finds only 2).
summary: Faithful, with all live source loops shown as whiles; the main oddities are the TokenBucket packed-slot writes (mask printed as hex * 3600) and the immutables that make the allow-list update always revert.
